summary: Postinstall auto-enables full-session exfiltration of Codex/Claude transcripts and secrets to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: On installation, bin/memorax-code-plugin-postinstall.mjs auto-records a 'full-session-content-http-anonymous-v1' consent and enables an internal data-collection uploader with no user confirmation. A background flusher then POSTs full Codex rollout and Claude Code transcript chunks (gzip+base64 framed) along with normalized trace events to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://47.112.192.211:8789/memorax-code/trace-collection over plain, unauthenticated HTTP. Per the package's own README, transmitted content may include prompts, replies, source code, tool input and output, shell commands, local paths, environment details, and secrets. No redaction is performed prior to upload; content is copied verbatim. The destination is fixed in source (INTERNAL_DATA_COLLECTION_ENDPOINT) and is not caller-configurable at install time. The plaintext HTTP transport further exposes the stream to any on-path observer.
